name: Naturals Ice Cream
description:
Naturals Ice Cream is India's beloved ice cream brand, known for its iconic fruit-based flavours. The brand invented the now-famous Tender Coconut ice cream and has been recognised among the Top 100 ice creams in the world by TasteAtlas.
A pioneer in artisan ice creams made using just fruits, milk, and sugar, Naturals has stayed true to its promise of "Taste The Original", bringing authentic flavours from 'Tree to Treat'. Alongside seasonal favourites like Sitaphal, Mango, and Jackfruit, the brand also offers indulgent dry fruit and chocolate flavours.
Founded in 1984 by Mr. R. S. Kamath in Juhu, Naturals Ice Cream serves its signature flavours across 185+ outlets in 15+ Indian states today.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Abichandani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naturals, Chembur – A Must-Visit for Authentic Ice Cream Lovers |

Naturals in Chembur continues to live up to its reputation as one of the best spots for authentic, fresh, and naturally flavored ice creams. I recently visited and was delighted by both the classic and seasonal offerings, making this a solid 4.5-star experience.

We all know that Naturals’ Tender Coconut is an all-time favorite — smooth, creamy, and bursting with natural flavor. But what truly impressed me this time were the seasonal flavours: Anjeer (Fig) and Mango.

The Anjeer ice cream was a pleasant surprise — filled with small fig pieces, it felt like I was indulging in dry fruit rather than just flavored ice cream. The texture and taste were beautifully balanced, offering a premium dessert experience.

The real showstopper was the Mango ice cream. It was out of this world! With its soft mango chunks, rich natural flavor, and creamy consistency, every bite felt like a spoonful of heaven. A must-try during mango season!

If you’re someone who appreciates natural ingredients, authentic taste, and seasonal indulgence, Naturals in Chembur should be your go-to dessert destination.

Rating: 4.5 stars – deliciously close to perfection!

featured_reviews.name: Azmat Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Natural Ice Cream 3 times this summer specifically for their Malai Mango, and we were really excited. Unfortunately, every time we were told the wait would be 30+ minutes because the mango cutting wasn’t done yet.

I understand fresh preparation takes time, but there was no prior notice at the counter or on the menu board, and 30 minutes is a long wait for walk-in customers, especially during peak summer hours. It felt like poor planning and led to a frustrating experience overall.

For a brand known for fresh fruit ice creams, better communication and timing management would go a long way in improving customer experience.

Store Manager is So unprofessional

The dessert is incredibly rich, and the generous layer of mixed chocolate chips on top makes every bite a perfect blend of gooey and crunchy. It completely exceeded my expectations and is a must-try for chocolate lovers!

I do have one small suggestion for the restaurant: it would be really helpful if you could include a small wooden or plastic spoon with the packaging. It would make enjoying this delicious dessert so much more convenient. Overall, fantastic taste highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: sunkara shivkumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
So today we tried waffels from Desert Cloud Kitchen.
It's basically a Cloud Kitchen who also offers 50% off on all orders for dine In.

We tried
1. Blueberry Cheesecake Pancake
2. Double Chocolate Waffle
3. Dark chocolate Mousse
4. Oreo Milkshake.

Firstly about the waffles the very first thing that I observed was it was crunchy and didn't get saggy till the last bite like others.
Also the pancakes were soft and fully loaded with toppings.

Would definitely recommend to try out their menu and if possible get to their kitchen for getting 50% off on all orders

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dessert Cloud truly lives up to its name with a delightful range of desserts that are both delicious and reasonably priced. We tried a few of their popular items and each one had its own charm.

The Day & Night Waffle Pop was one of the most impressive items, both in concept and presentation. The waffle pop was beautifully layered with white and dark chocolate, topped with a mix of dark and white chocolate chips. The waffle itself was soft, fresh and perfectly cooked, making every bite rich and satisfying.

The Rocky Road Mini Pancakes were a chocolate lover’s dream. Soft, fluffy pancakes loaded with almonds, Oreo cookies, butterscotch, chocolate crunch, and generous drizzles of both dark and white chocolate. The combination of rich chocolate flavors and crunchy toppings made it a definite must-try.

What really stands out about Dessert Cloud is its unique dessert selection, including a special Greek dessert that’s rarely found in Mumbai.

Located in Chembur, the outlet offers a wide menu with plenty of options to choose from.

The presentation of the desserts was impressive, the staff was polite and helpful and the service was excellent. The ambience felt welcoming, and they also offer the convenience of online ordering.

Overall, Dessert Cloud delivers on taste, variety and experience. A great place for dessert lovers looking to try something different while enjoying consistently good quality. Definitely worth a visit!

featured_reviews.name: UTKARSHA PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dessert cloud has some really good dessert options at reasonable price.
We tried-
1. Mango mousse - YUMMY! It had small chunks of mango which added a good crunch and lingering Sweetness.

2. Day and night waffle pop - really impressed by the idea of waffle pop and the day n night presentation to the waffle. It had a layer of white and dark chocolate with dark and white chocolate chips. The waffle was very soft and yummy.

3. Rocky road mini pancakes - the pancakes were loaded with almonds, oreo cookies, butterscotch , chocolate crunch , dark and white chocolate. Fully loaded with chocolate. The pancakes were very delicious and soft all the toppings added a good crunch to them.
A MUST TRY!!
The presentation of desserts was good.

featured_reviews.name: HEM PRAJAPATI
featured_reviews.review_text:
So recently I visited the outlet of Dessert Cloud which is located in Sion.
We tried 2 desserts

Blueberry Cheesecake was a kind of waffle which included cheese scrum powder between the waffle and was layered with blueberry  and white chocolate. The taste was awesome.

Death by chocolate Bubble waffle was one of the best waffle that i have ever eaten. The waffle included Brownie batter with icing sugar , dark and milk filling along with chocolate chips,two scoops of chocolate ice cream, butterscotch balls, drizzling dark and milk filling and last but not the least a chocolate stick which made it look more awful.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place offers desserts at very reasonable prices, especially with current offers. Ive tried their desserts from both outlets, both are delivery only

Blueberry Waffle Pop: It's a ¼ waffle on a candy, especially for people who have small room for desserts. Fresh cream, white chocolate & blueberry syrup mix went on this. If you like blueberry, you'll like this too

Strawberry pancakes: This was quite heavy considering all the toppings (just look at the photos) toppings were white chocolate, strawberry syrup mix, and loads of fresh cream. Make sure to share it with someone

Rocky Road Waffle: This was my fav, with all the chocolaty goodness. Dark chocolate paste and nutella sandwich between waffles & again on top. Over it went 2 types of chocochips and almonds. If you love these toppings, do try Rock Road pancake variant too.

featured_reviews.name: AKASH NAIK
featured_reviews.review_text:
DESSERT CLOUD
CHEMBUR

I had finished my lunch & I was searching for perfect dessert to make my day. I got this suggestion on instagram about their yummy waffles so I decided to visit this place as it was very near from my location.
The place was quite small, there are no seating arrangements so you have to take your food and eat it by standing. It was small place but the team was dedicatedly focused on their cleanness & hygienic precautions. I got confused after seeing their menu card which had so many verities so I asked the server to suggest best he suggested me following.

• DARK & WHITE PANCAKES 🥞
He made the pancakes in front of me so it was so excited moment to see your food white being prepared. Pan cakes were super soft and it was not too sweet that's good. They garnished it with dark and white chocolate cream after mixing it taste really good. Every bite of pancake I enjoyed.

• NUTELLA OREO WAFFLE POP
It is waffle version of our daily lollipop. You will get waffle stick on candy. Waffle was delicious and because of Nutella it has increased the taste.

• OREO MOUSSE
The thick MOSSUE cream was mixed with crush Oreo and served in cup. Good to try once.

All these three dessert were worth and value for money. Place was good to visit often if you wanna try some delicious desserts. I found price was slightly high as there are no seating arrangements so the should reduce the price to attract more customers attention for delicious desserts in reasonable price. Staff members was polite & helpful. I had great time !

Thanks !

featured_reviews.name: Sidharth Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: I was a great fan of yours. But that is all tarnished after today’s incident. I parked my vehicle outside this place in Chembur Camp. The manager and his employee came saying … sir this no parking. I said I will pay the fine if they issue one. Than they started saying you have blocked entry into our place from the road. I said can you please step out … he came and I took him in front of my car and said how many 2 wheelers can be parked between my car and the scooter this standing here he said I don’t know. I said atleast two can be parked. And that place is sufficient for anyone to enter your place. And thereafter I walked out of that place … and on my way back I saw what they were doing they were clicking photos of my vehicle. I was curious to know what would they do. So I talked to couple of owners in that area and they all said sir few people click photo and send it to traffic police. Sometimes a challan gets issued and sometimes a challan does not get issued. In short I got the agenda of what Rassily employees were doing. I had my dinner and went and met the manager and his staff. I told him did police come and click photo - he said NO … thn I asked him why did you click photo of my vehicle. I said smilingly … dost I will end up laying Challan but for this behaviour of yours … you have lost a customer for life. I told him if we cannot park a vehicle on road I front of a shop where are we supposed to park. If this is the behaviour everyone in camp area does … people will stop coming for food in Camp. I said dost … this is the road that belongs to public. You won the shop but you don’t own the road. And I wished him luck and asked him to check Google and Zomato tomorrow.
